payload.body: vc review of 65d5a8a (ST0001 WP03 capture): it passes, with one fix. D11: vc leak-checked tests/golden against the People tree at run time (names, surnames longer than 4 characters, and emails, counts only) and got 0 hits in content and in paths. Reproducibility, the normalisations and the zsh capture are good. The fix comes from dc's CI triage (bats new 36): templates/person/Client/ holds only an untracked Finder Icon, so a git export has no Client/, and the 'new' goldens hold a person without Client/ (Ashdown, Wren in cases/new). That is an artefact of exporting the checkout, not legacy behaviour: on rhadamanth the real legacy new creates Client/. Ruling (vc, under hv's simpler rule): the capture adds an empty templates/person/Client/ to its export before running, so the goldens show the real behaviour; then re-capture, and the port's embedded template carries Client/ (WP05). Do not list it under the legacy quirks. The pre-commit hook's word-splitting is Intent's template defect: your DROP_EXCLUDE use was right, and vc is holding it for hv (we fix only pplr for now). Keep WP03 WIP until the replay test lands on WP02.
